overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee approved space efficiency reductions totaling approximately 20,000 square feet and $22 million in estimated savings. The committee also finalized a 477-space parking plan and discussed MSBA feedback prior to entering the schematic design phase.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and July Invoices
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from July 21, 2026, and authorized payment of $134,354.50 for project management and architectural services.

items.title: Welcoming of New Committee Members
items.summary: Formally introduced and welcomed Liz Mullane, Tracy Keene, Jen Belanger, and Kim Clinton to the building committee following School Committee appointments.

items.title: Sustainability and Systems Report
items.summary: Reviewed sustainability goals including LEED Silver certification, net-zero energy targets, and an upcoming community eco-charrette scheduled for September 17.

items.title: Space Review: Medford Community Media
items.summary: Approved eliminating 1,400 square feet of dedicated studio space to utilize a shared model with the vocational film and television program.

items.title: Space Review: Community Partner Rentals
items.summary: Approved removing 910 square feet of storage space for outside renters to align with updated School Committee rental policies.

items.title: Space Review: Community Meeting Space
items.summary: Approved eliminating dedicated community multi-purpose and language lab spaces by transitioning these functions to flexible Large Group Instruction rooms.

items.title: Space Review: Health and Physical Education
items.summary: Approved the elimination of a dedicated yoga and CPR room and a reduction of 1,000 square feet in total locker room area.

items.title: Space Review: Auditorium and Drama
items.summary: Approved reducing auditorium seating from 1,000 to 750 seats, resulting in a 2,500 square foot reduction to create a more intimate performance environment.

items.title: Space Review: Art and Music
items.summary: Approved a reduction in the digital art and photography lab by removing the traditional darkroom facility from the program.

items.title: Square Footage and Cost Savings Summary
items.summary: Reviewed a cumulative summary showing the approved space changes and high-rise code exemptions total $25.7 million in estimated project cost savings.

items.title: Parking Program Review
items.summary: Approved a parking plan totaling 477 spaces, accounting for staff requirements, student drivers, and shared visitor spaces.

items.title: MSBA Feedback and Preferred Schematic Report
items.summary: Discussed MSBA comments on the project's Preferred Schematic Report and prepared for the formal vote to move into the schematic design phase.

subject: High School Project Space Reductions
